runs.name: basic create

runs.name: matched rowcount
runs.sql: SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected

runs.name: unmatched insert
runs.sql: MERGE dbo.merge_target AS t USING (VALUES (4,40)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n) OUTPUT $action AS action, inserted.id AS inserted_id, inserted.n AS current_n;

runs.sql: MERGE dbo.merge_target AS t USING (VALUES (1),(2),(4)) AS s(id) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND t.id=3 THEN DELETE OUTPUT $action AS action, deleted.id AS deleted_id, deleted.n AS prior_n;

runs.sql: SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected

runs.name: mixed create
runs.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_mix(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NOT NULL)

runs.name: mixed seed
runs.sql: INSERT dbo.merge_mix(id,n) VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)

runs.name: mixed output create
runs.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_output([action] NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,inserted_id INT NULL,deleted_id INT NULL)

runs.name: mixed actions
runs.sql:
MERGE dbo.merge_mix AS t
    USING (VALUES (1,11),(2,22),(4,44)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id
    WHEN MATCHED AND s.id=1 THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n
    WHEN MATCHED AND s.id=2 THEN DELETE
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND t.id=3 THEN DELETE
    OUTPUT $action, inserted.id, deleted.id INTO dbo.merge_output([action],inserted_id,deleted_id);

runs.name: mixed rowcount
runs.sql: SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected

runs.sql: SELECT [action],inserted_id,deleted_id FROM dbo.merge_output ORDER BY [action],COALESCE(inserted_id,deleted_id)

runs.sql: SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_mix ORDER BY id
